title: Mass of online prophecies of 9/11

tellings.quote: there's a million I mean there's a million there uh prophecies whatever you want to call them of 911

plain: Eric Wargo, a writer on dreams and the ability to sense the future, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2024 about the attacks on New York on September 11, 2001. He says there were countless prophecies of the event, many shared online, which he takes as a sign that people can glimpse big events before they happen.
